# anthropic_vault (Resource)

Manages an Anthropic Vault (`vlt_…`) — a container for stored credentials that Deployments can reference via `vault_ids`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anthropic_vault" "example" {
  display_name = "readme-updater credentials"

  metadata = {
    team = "platform"
    env  = "prod"
  }

  # Hard-delete the Vault on `terraform destroy` instead of the default
  # archive-only behavior.
  delete_on_destroy = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name for the Vault.

### Optional

- `delete_on_destroy` (Boolean) Whether `terraform destroy` hard-deletes the Vault instead of archiving it. This is a provider-only setting — it is never sent to or read from the API. Defaults to `false` (archive).
- `metadata` (Map of String) Free-form string metadata attached to the Vault.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Vault was archived, if ever.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Vault was created.
- `id` (String) ID of the Vault (`vlt_…`).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Vault was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing vault by ID
terraform import anthropic_vault.example vlt_xxxxx
```
